description: Moves a track to another layout for its schema (a ready-made template like a monthly budget, by its id), or to its template's newest version: adds the tabs it brings and sets each column's allowed values. The person's rows and own tabs stay as they are. list_tracks shows templateUpdate when a newer version is out, labelled like semver: patch changes only words, minor adds tabs or allowed values, major is for another schema version or takes allowed values away (rows already there may stop fitting). Ask the person before moving their sheet, and say which kind it is.
name: change_template
title: Change a track's sheet template
